Privacy policy

We do not sell your personal information to anyone. We honour the Global Privacy Control signal from your browser.

You have the right to request that we delete your personal data at any time, and we will do so within 30 days. We retain subscription records for 12 months after your subscription ends, as required by tax law.

We use first-party analytics to understand which recipes are popular. We do not use advertising trackers on recipe pages.
